quotes.title: TOI-5624
quotes.card: TOI-5624 is a Sun-like star located in the zodiacal constellation Ursa Major, approximately 331 light-years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: Four sub-Neptunes, identified via transit photometry, are in orbit around the star, accompanied by an outer companion detected through transit timing variations.

notes: TOI-5624 f: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by transit timing variations)
